articles.title: LeBron James’ $550,000 Mercedes Maybach fails to meet expectations as auction sale brings in less than estimated

articles.body: LeBron James, the four time NBA champion, has raised millions for his charity, the LeBron James Family Foundation, which directly benefits his hometown in Ohio. While he remains busy with his career in the league, LeBron James’ custom designed Mercedes Maybach does not seem to have made the money as many had hoped.LeBron James’ custom made Mercedes Maybach does not make the money it had intended to even after being constantly promotedAs per reports, a bespoke Mercedes Maybach S 680 designed by LeBron James sold for $390,000 at a Gooding Christie's auction during Rétromobile New York on November 20, 2026, below its pre-sale estimate of $425,000 to $550,000.This has raised eyebrows considering both LeBron James and Mercedes Maybach had been regularly promoting the collaboration for the last couple of months.Even just a few days ago, Mercedes Maybach made a post in collaboration with LeBron James which read as, “Every legend was once a kid with a dream. @kingjames has designed a unique Mercedes-Maybach with a greater purpose.”The post added, “Now, this extraordinary car is going up for auction to support the @ljfamfoundation, helping children pursue their dreams and become the legends of tomorrow.⁣ ⁣ On auction this Friday, November 20th with @goodingandcompany at @retromobile_nyc.”The luxurious Mercedes Maybach was crafted via the MANUFAKTUR Made to Measure program, with one vehicle kept by LeBron James and a near identical twin auctioned. It finished in a MANUFAKTUR-exclusive Light Ivory paint with matching solid-dish wheels and front-fender "LBJ" brandingA few months ago, in an interview, the former Los Angeles Lakers’ icon LeBron James had reflected on it as he said, “The chance to design my own customized Mercedes-Maybach was something I never even dreamed of as a young kid growing up in Akron.”The star player added, “To now have the opportunity to uplift my community and the families we serve through this auction means everything to my Foundation as we continue to build an ecosystem of supports that allows them to live out their dreams as well.”The proceeds from the sale of the Mercedes Maybach benefit the LeBron James Family Foundation's I PROMISE program in James's hometown of Akron, Ohio, supporting students and families with education, housing, healthcare, job training, and financial literacy.However, with the luxurious car selling below the estimated price, LeBron james has remained silent about it.LeBron James remains focused on his careerFor now, the focus remains on his impressive performance in the league.In his 24th NBA season with the Philadelphia 76ers, LeBron James has averaged 16.6 points, 6.7 rebounds, and 6.5 assists across 14 games (33.4 minutes per game), shooting 47.5% from the field and 27.5% from three.He has hit his stride recently with three straight 20-point outings, including a season-high 23 points in a 128–111 loss to the Portland Trail Blazers on November 24, 2026.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates.
